findings.explanation: Your payments are conditional on the client receiving funds from third-party carriers, meaning you bear the risk of delayed or missed payments if the carriers do not pay.
findings.suggested_change: All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few updates prior to signing. - Regarding the relevant clause ("All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis upon receipt from the wireless carriers in the Territory, except as follows:"), it conditions our payments on third-party carrier funds, which creates payment delay risks. I propose modifying it to: "All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter." Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
